examples.title: The Tripartite Struggle
examples.problem: Why did three major kingdoms fight for the city of Kanauj?
examples.solution: Kanauj was located in the fertile Ganga valley and was a center of trade and power.
examples.explanation: Controlling Kanauj meant controlling the wealth of the entire northern region.

examples.title: Chola Administration
examples.problem: How did the Cholas manage their villages?
examples.solution: They used local assemblies called 'Ur' and 'Sabha' where village elders made decisions.
examples.explanation: This was an early form of self-government at the local level.
